# scene object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sceneObject`](gmeow-sceneObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sceneObject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

The object region in a scene-graph edge — the region toward which the relation points. Functional per edge: one object per [`SceneGraphEdge`](../classes/gmeow-SceneGraphEdge.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SceneGraphEdge`](../classes/gmeow-SceneGraphEdge.md) -> [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](../classes/gmeow-ImageRegion.md); functional
